scripts.codeanalyzer:run: mkdir -p sfca && sf code-analyzer run --rule-selector '(pmd,cpd,sfge,regex):(Recommended,Custom)' --output-file sfca/sfca_results.json --include-suggestions --include-fixes --output-file sfca/sfca_results.html
scripts.codeanalyzer:setup: echo y | sf code-analyzer config --output-file code-analyzer.yml --config-file code-analyzer.yml --include-unmodified-rules --rule-selector '(pmd,cpd,sfge,regex):(Recommended,Custom)' && sh scripts/strip-config-paths.sh code-analyzer.yml && prettier --write code-analyzer.yml
